title: Grey-boxing the world.
summary: So as you can see, I began to create the elements of the terrain. I used for me, a Massive! 9 terrain squares for this part. I scaled a character and OH MY GOD! I know RPG's have expansive worlds, but WOW!
points: - Grey-boxed the map as a whole. Added mountain range, and ocean layer

title: Adding Terrain.
summary: Using the terrain painter asset, I then added the layers. Starting with a gritty stone layer, then followed by a mossy grass layer. this gave what I think, is a nice effect, and a feeling of a wild, wide open scottish expanse!
